title: justicia keriana
intro: Justicia keriana, commonly known as the "wild empress", is a flowering plant species native to tropical regions. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving respiratory health, due to its therapeutic actions as an expectorant and anti-inflammatory agent. The bioactive constituents of Justicia keriana, including flavonoids and phenolic acids, are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties. However, further research is needed to fully understand the plant's effects and potential applications.
